description: Russia plans to launch the Venera-D mission to Venus in 2036. The mission will include an orbiter, balloon probe and lander to study Venus’s atmosphere, clouds and surface, while searching for possible microbial life and continuing the legacy of Soviet Venus exploration.
title: Russia Plans Venera-D Mission to Venus in 2036 With Lander, Orbiter, and Balloon Probe

description: Selecting the right printer for all your home printing needs can be overwhelming due to the sheer number of options available across different price points. Here we have listed some of the top laser printers available in India for home printing. The list includes HP 303dw, HP 323sdnw, Canon MF3010, HP 303d and Brother DCP-L2541DW. The HP 323sdnw, Canon MF3010 and Brother DCP-L2541DW provide printing, scanning, and copying in a single device.
title: Best Laser Printers in India for Home Printing Needs

description: Huawei has made a dedicated microsite for another tablet in India, confirming its imminent arrival in the country. Dubbed Huawei MatePad SE 11, the tablet will go on sale in the country via Flipkart. The tech firm has also revealed the effective pricing of the Huawei MatePad SE 11 in India. It will be equipped with Huawei’s 11-inch Eye Comfort display. The upcoming MatePad series tablet will also be backed by a 7,700mAh battery. It will also support 22.5W wired fast charging. The Huawei tablet will boast a metal unibody design and a single rear camera unit.
title: Huawei MatePad SE 11 Price in India Revealed as Company Confirms Imminent Launch in the Country

description: The Realme C100i has appeared on Thailand’s NBTC certification platform with model number RMX5377, confirming 4G LTE support ahead of launch. The device has also surfaced on TKDN and EEC listings. Online retail listings suggest it may feature a 6.8-inch display, up to 4GB RAM, and a 6,000mAh battery. Meanwhile, a Realme C100 5G variant is also expected, with a Dimensity 6300 chipset, 144Hz display, and pricing starting at EUR 237 (roughly Rs. 23,000).
title: Realme C100i Spotted on NBTC Certification Database as Key Features Surface Online via Retailer Listings

description: Dreame L40 Ultra AE and Dreame D20 Ultra robot vacuum cleaners have been launched in India. They offer vacuuming and mopping functions and include 5,200mAh battery units. The charging docks of the robots feature bags with a 3.2 litre capacity that are claimed to last up to 100 days. The  Dreame L40 Ultra AE has 19,000Pa suction power, while the D20 Ultra has 13,000Pa suction power.
title: Dreame L40 Ultra AE Robot Vacuum With 19,000Pa Vormax Suction Launched in India, Dreame D20 Ultra Tags Along

description: Itel has unveiled the new Zeno AI Weaver in India, as the Chinese tech firm's first AI-powered voice recorder in India. The AI device is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Amazon, as a dedicated microsite for the voice recorder was recently made live. It will be offered in a single black colourway. The company claims that the device will provide up to 40 hours of voice recording capacity. It is capable of summarising and translating voice recordings. The device also features a recording indicator on the front.
title: Itel Unveils Zeno AI Weaver Voice Recorder in India With Up to 40 Hours Recording Capacity, Live Transcription

description: Laalo: Krishna Sada Sahaayate is a Gujarati spiritual family drama film that has finally made its way to the digital screens.
title: Laalo: Krishna Sada Sahaayate Out on OTT: Know Where to Watch it Online

description: Marshall has launched the Bromley 450 party speaker in India, priced at Rs. 74,999. The portable Bluetooth speaker offers 360-degree sound, integrated stage lights, and support for microphone and instrument inputs. It features multiple drivers, Class D amplifiers, and supports Bluetooth 5.3 with Auracast. The speaker includes a replaceable LFP battery with over 40 hours of claimed playback and fast charging support. It also carries an IP55 rating, supports wired connectivity options, and comes with a built-in handle for portability.
title: Marshall Bromley 450 Launched in India With 360-Degree Sound, Up to 40-Hour Battery Life: Price, Features

description: The Oppo Find X9s is expected to be launched in China soon as the latest addition to the Find X9 series. However, a leak suggests that it could be joined by a Pro variant. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the upcoming handset, dubbed the Find X9s Pro, is said to have been spotted on a benchmarking site, which hints towards its imminent debut in the region. It is also speculated to be available in the global markets with slightly different specifications compared to the Chinese model.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro Reportedly Bags 3C Certification Ahead of Launch in China: Expected Specifications

description: Poco X8 Pro, OnePlus Nord 5, and Realme 16 Pro compete in India’s mid-range segment with AMOLED displays, large batteries, and capable chipsets. The Poco X8 Pro offers a 120Hz display, Dimensity 8500 Ultra chip, and 100W charging. The OnePlus Nord 5 features a Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 processor, 144Hz display, and 6,800mAh battery. The Realme 16 Pro stands out with a 200-megapixel camera and a 7,000mAh battery. All three devices offer competitive pricing and features.
title: Poco X8 Pro vs OnePlus Nord 5 vs Realme 16 Pro 5G: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: UK lawmakers have proposed a temporary ban on cryptocurrency donations to political parties, citing risks of foreign interference and weak transparency. A parliamentary committee has recommended pausing such contributions until stricter verification systems are introduced. The move is part of broader efforts to strengthen political funding rules, though it could also slow crypto adoption in regulated sectors.
title: UK Parliamentary Committee Seeks Temporary Ban on Crypto Donations Over Foreign Influence Risks

description: BTS Return is a documentary that explores BTS’s reunion and their creative journey while working on their new album, offering fans exclusive behind-the-scenes access.
title: BTS Return Documentary OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Fourth Floor is a Tamil supernatural thriller about a man trapped in eerie dreams and mysterious events at a secluded guest house.
title: Fourth Floor OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Google is now expanding Personal Intelligence to more users in the US. The feature, which allows the chatbot to connect to various Google apps and draw context to generate personalised responses, was first introduced in January. At the time, it was only available to US-based paying users. Now, the capability is available inside the Gemini app, Gemini assistant in Google Chrome, and via AI Mode in Search to those on the free tier.
title: Google’s Personal Intelligence Is Now Rolling Out to More Users

description: Karuppu is a high-budget Tamil action-drama starring Suriya, set for theatrical release before streaming on Netflix.
title: Karuppu OTT Release Reportedly Revealed Online: What You Need to Know

description: OnePlus Nord 6 will be launched at a higher price in India than last year’s OnePlus Nord 5, according to a tipster. The phone is said to cost Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 5,000 more than its predecessor. Moreover, it could be offered in India in 8GB + 256GB and 12GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. Recently, a report suggested that OnePlus could also launch the Nord CE 6 along with the standard model. However, a leaker claims that the phone might not arrive in India for now. Separately, another tipster has spotted the OnePlus Nord 6 on the Geekbench benchmarking platform.
title: OnePlus Nord 6 Said to Be More Expensive Than Nord 5 in India; Geekbench Listing Hints at Snapdragon Chip Upgrade

description: OpenAI introduced two new artificial intelligence (AI) models in the GPT-5.4 family on Tuesday. Dubbed GPT-5.4 mini and GPT-5.4 nano, the two smaller AI models are faster compared to the larger models in the family, and are aimed at low-latency workloads. Some of the key strengths of these models include coding proficiency, computer use, multimodal understanding, and subagent handling.
title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-5.4 Mini, Nano as Faster Models Optimised for Coding and AI Agents

description: Garmin has introduced WhatsApp support on select smartwatches through a new app available on the Connect IQ Store. The feature works on models across the Fenix, Forerunner, Venu, and Vívoactive series and requires a paired smartphone. Users can read and reply to messages, view recent chats, and decline calls from the watch. The app supports up to 10 conversation threads and offers media previews, but not media sharing. WhatsApp remains end-to-end encrypted, and the feature is limited to personal accounts.
title: Garmin Introduces WhatsApp App for Select Fenix, Forerunner, Venu Series Smartwatches

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Galaxy M47 5G, and Galaxy F70 Pro 5G have been spotted on the GSMA database with model numbers SM-S741B/DS, SM-M476B/DS and SM-E476B/DS, respectively. The appearance of new Galaxy smartphones on the GSMA website suggests that Samsung has begun work on its next set of mid-range smartphones. Samsung Galaxy S26 FE will succeed last year's Galaxy S25 FE.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Galaxy M47 5G and Galaxy F70 Pro 5G Reportedly Surface on GSMA Database

description: The US SEC has introduced its first formal framework to determine when crypto assets qualify as securities. The guidance evaluates tokens based on their function and use, rather than labels, and suggests that many digital assets may not fall under securities laws. The move is expected to provide greater clarity for traders, exchanges, and institutions, although some uncertainty around how rules will be applied may remain.
title: US SEC Defines Crypto Securities, Signals Clarity for US Traders and Institutions

description: Vivo V70 FE will be launched in India in early April, according to a tech blogger. On top of this, the price in India, key specifications, and features of the smartphone have surfaced online. The Vivo V70 FE is said to go on sale in the country via Amazon. However, the tech firm has yet to confirm these details. This comes weeks after the Vivo V70 FE was launched in Indonesia on March 9. The phone features a 4nm octa core MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Turbo SoC in Indonesia. It also packs a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Vivo V70 FE Price in India, Launch Timeline Leaked Days After Global Debut: Expected Price, Specifications

description: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick has shared his thoughts on the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) in the gaming industry. In a recent interview, the executive stated that while AI can assist developers in creating content, it is not expected to contribute to the development of blockbuster gaming titles. Zelnick’s comments come at a time when AI adoption in gaming continues to spark debate, especially after criticism around technologies like the recently previewed Nvidia DLSS 5.
title: AI Can Assist Game Development But Won't Create Hits, Says Take Two CEO Amid DLSS 5 Backlash

description: iFixit has shared a teardown video of the iPhone 17e, revealing its internal components and repairability score. The video shows that the latest MagSafe-enabled back panel is compatible with the iPhone 16e. So users can fit the MagSafe-equipped back panel from the iPhone 17e onto the iPhone 16e. The new phone has a dual-entry design, and it has a 15.556Wh battery. The iFixit teardown gives the iPhone 17e a seven out of 10 repairability score.
title: iPhone 17e Teardown Video Reveals Repairability Score, Easy MagSafe Upgrade for iPhone 16e

description: Xiaomi 17 series is expected to be launched soon in select global markets as the China-based tech giant’s fourth model in its flagship lineup. The handset has reportedly been certified by the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) in Singapore. The handset is said to have been listed on the Singaporean regulator’s database with the 2602DPT53G model number, revealing that it will ship with Bluetooth, WiFi, and NFC connectivity. Recently, a tipster claimed, citing industry sources, that the Xiaomi 17T will be launched in India at the end of April or in May.
title: Xiaomi 17T Launch Seems Imminent as Phone Reportedly Bags Singapore's IMDA Certification

description: Bitcoin hovered near the $74,000 mark as crypto markets remained range-bound ahead of the US Federal Reserve decision. Analysts said ETF inflows and institutional accumulation are supporting prices, but resistance near $75,000 continues to limit upside. Market direction is expected to hinge on the Fed’s tone around inflation and future policy signals.
title: Bitcoin Nears Key Resistance Ahead of Anticipated US Fed Policy Decision

description: Beats and Nike have launched the Powerbeats Pro 2 Nike Special Edition earbuds, marking their first collaboration on the product line. Priced at Rs. 29,900 in India, the earbuds will be available from March 20. They feature dual branding, secure-fit earhooks, and IPX4-rated sweat and water resistance. The earbuds support Active Noise Cancellation, spatial audio, and heart rate tracking with app integration. Powered by Apple’s H2 chip, they are claimed to offer up to 45 hours of battery life and support Bluetooth 5.3 with cross-platform compatibility.
title: Powerbeats Pro 2 Nike Special Edition Launched in India With Apple's H2 Chip, ANC

description: Adobe and Nvidia announced a strategic partnership at the GPU Technology Conference (GTC) on Monday. This collaboration focuses on artificial intelligence (AI). It spans agentic creativity and marketing workflows, the development of the next-generation Firefly models, and the integration of Nvidia’s platforms into Adobe products.
title: Adobe, Nvidia Join Hands to Build the Next Generation of Firefly Models

description: Amazon has introduced 1-hour and 3-hour delivery options in the US, expanding its same-day delivery network. Customers can order from over 90,000 products, including household essentials, electronics, and more. The service is available across hundreds of cities for 1-hour delivery and over 2,000 locations for 3-hour delivery. Prime members pay lower fees and get free delivery on millions of items. The system uses local fulfilment hubs and predictive inventory placement. Amazon is also testing a 30-minute delivery service called Amazon Now.
title: Amazon Rolls Out 1-Hour and 3-Hour Delivery Across Several US Cities and Towns

description: Huawei MatePad 11.5 is now confirmed to be launched in India by the Chinese tech giant. The dedicated microsite for the upcoming tablet has been updated to reveal the key specifications, features, and effective pricing of the MatePad 11.5 in the country. It is confirmed to go on sale in India in at least two colour options, pink and silver. The tablet will also ship with a detachable keyboard. It is also shown to feature stylus support. The tech giant will allow customers to purchase the MatePad 11.5 with up to a six-month interest-free EMI, too. It is confirmed to sport an 11.5-inch 2.5K PaperMatte display.
title: Huawei MatePad 11.5 Price in India, Launch Teased Along With Key Specifications

description: Oppo A6s 5G has been launched in India on Wednesday. The new Oppo A series smartphone arrived in two distinct colourways with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset under the hood. The Oppo A6s 5G launched in two RAM and storage configurations, and it has a dual rear camera unit headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor. The Oppo A6s 5G features a 6,500mAh battery with 44W fast charging support.
title: Oppo A6s 5G Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo is gearing up to launch the X300 Ultra and Vivo X300s soon. The company has posted new teasers on Weibo highlighting the camera capabilities of the upcoming X series handsets. Vivo has introduced a new in-house imaging system called Blueprint Native Color, designed to deliver natural tones. The Vivo X300 Ultra will also feature dedicated cinematic video modes, including Film Style and Film Look. The Film Style mode uses a 2.4:1 format with a 24fps frame rate, while the Film Look adopts a 16:9 aspect ratio with 60fps.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300s Teased to Feature New 'BluePrint Native' Colour Technology

description: The Xiaomi 17 series is now available for purchase in India. The flagship lineup from the China-based company comprises two models — Xiaomi 17 and Xiaomi 17 Ultra. Both handsets were launched in the country on March 11, about a week after their global debut. They are powered by Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. The Xiaomi 17 and 17 Ultra are equipped with Leica-powered cameras, with the latter featuring Leica's 1-inch LOFIC sensor.
title: Xiaomi 17, Xiaomi 17 Ultra With Leica Optics and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip Go on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Reliance Jio is said to have announced a new benefit for international travellers. According to a report, the telecom service provider (TSP) now offers free incoming SMS support over Wi-Fi calling (VoWiFi) at no additional cost. Users can reportedly receive important messages abroad without requiring an active international roaming (IR) pack. The move is aimed at helping users stay connected while abroad without incurring additional roaming charges, especially for receiving important messages like OTPs and banking alerts.
title: Jio Reportedly Offers Free Incoming SMS Over VoWiFi Without Roaming Pack for International Travellers

description: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G and Galaxy A37 5G prices in Thailand have surfaced online with the leaked posters of the upcoming smartphones. Moreover, the marketing material of the Galaxy A57 5G has also been leaked, revealing its camera configurations and dimensions. Samsung’s upcoming Galaxy A series phone is expected to sport a triple rear unit, housed inside a pill-shaped camera module. The handset could be equipped with a 50-megapixel main camera, along with a 12-megapixel ultrawide camera and a 5-megapixel macro camera.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G, Galaxy A37 5G Camera Configurations and Pricing Details Leaked

description: OnePlus on Wednesday announced the launch date of its upcoming compact mid-flagship smartphone. The handset, dubbed OnePlus 15T, will be launched in the country next week, bringing a culmination to weeks of leaks and rumours. Pre-orders of the smartphone have already been made live, which reveal that the brand will introduce five RAM and storage configurations. The OnePlus 15T is confirmed to be available in three different colourways, including black and white shades.
title: OnePlus 15T China Launch Date Announced for March 24; to Be Available in Five RAM, Storage Variants
